definitions.explanation: One's own personal or private business, as opposed to public or work matters. Often used to preface a personal remark.

examples.japanese: {私事|わたくしごと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{恐縮|きょうしゅく}→恐縮：07596_kyoushuku⟧です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: If I may share a personal matter, I'm getting married next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{私事|わたくしごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}まない→持ち込む：04226_mochikomu⟧。
examples.english: to not bring personal matters into work.
I feel reluctant to take time off work for personal reasons.

notes:
A polite, slightly formal word for one's own private affairs. The set phrase {私事|わたくしごと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{恐縮|きょうしゅく}→恐縮：07596_kyoushuku⟧です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ humbly introduces a personal topic, often in a speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {私事|わたくしごと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{恐縮|きょうしゅく}→恐縮：07596_kyoushuku⟧です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧: if I may mention a personal matter
- {私事|わたくしごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}む→持ち込む：04226_mochikomu⟧: to bring in personal matters

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {私事|しじ}: the same kanji read しじ — also 'private affairs,' more bookish
- {公事|こうじ}: public or official matters — the antonym
